from scipy.optimize import least_squares
E=np.asarray(df['eps']);T=np.asarray(df['T']);S=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
St=np.var(S)
fams={
 'eps^p exp(q/T), T^s, const': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*T)*E**2 + p[2]*E**p[3]*np.exp(p[4]/T) + p[5]*T**p[6] + p[7],
 'eps^p exp(q/T), log T, eps': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*T)*E**2 + p[2]*E**p[3]*np.exp(p[4]/T) + p[5]*np.log(T) + p[6]*E,
 'eps^p T^q, exp(r eps) T^s': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*T)*E**2 + p[2]*E**p[3]*T**p[4] + p[5]*np.exp(p[6]*E)*T**p[7],
 'eps^p exp(q T), const, lin eps': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*T)*E**2 + p[2]*E**p[3]*np.exp(p[4]*T) + p[5] + p[6]*E,
 'exp(-q eps) T^s, eps^p exp(r/T)': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*T)*E**2 + p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*E)*T**p[4] + p[5]*E**p[6]*np.exp(p[7]/T)+p[8],
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,f in fams.items():
    bestv=9;bp=None
    npar=max(int(s) for s in [9])
    for trial in range(60):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,9)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-S, p0, max_nfev=400)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/St
            if np.isfinite(v) and v<bestv: bestv=v;bp=r.x
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, bestv, np.round(bp,3) if bp is not None else None)
